# x402 payments on Casper

> The x402 pay-per-request protocol on Casper: the protocol specification and its Casper 'exact' scheme from x402-foundation/x402, and the Casper facilitator implementation and guides from make-software/casper-x402.

Each link fetches the page's raw markdown; the URL after the colon is where it is published.
Generated by https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms from make-software/casper-x402@3ee705e, x402-foundation/x402@3c2ddfb.
